title: SYMBOL TUNING IMPROVES IN-CONTEXT LEARNING IN LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: Stance detection on the topic of atheism.
findings: The paper's general finding that symbol tuning improves performance on in-context learning tasks was also observed on the TEAT dataset, which measures stance detection on atheism. This suggests the method is effective even for tasks involving religious or ideological stances.
references: Ekin Akyürek, Dale Schuurmans, Jacob Andreas, Tengyu Ma, and Denny Zhou. What learning algorithm is in-context learning? Investigations with linear models. In International Conference on Learning Representations, 2023. URL https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.15661.
